text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp begins today.
The Umamusume will undergo thorough training
at the academy's special facility!

And Rhein Kraft, who had the Shuka Sho
waiting for her at the end of summer, was no exception...!
choice_data_list: (I need to get fired up too!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"You're here already!
Our bus just arrived a moment ago."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Heart-san sat close to me on the bus!
We both told each other
that neither of us was gonna lose the Shuka Sho!
choice_data_list: I love the passion, it's great.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, I feel just like the midsummer sun! Absolutely blaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta train as hard as I can during summer camp!
So I won't lose to Heart-san or Messiah-san—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Come to think of it, what is Cesario going to do about the Shuka Sho?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (I don't think I specifically talked about that, though...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, no no, what are you hesitating for!
Cesario's definitely running too!
This is the super important final leg of the Triple Tiara...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
Sorry, I was just lost in thought for a second.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway...!
Please train me
for the Shuka Sho!!"
